# Svelte UI Library Picker

> A secondary-source comparison of Svelte UI libraries: Svelte version support, components (mapped to a shared taxonomy), licenses, AI policies and live previews of default styles. Always defer to each library's official documentation, which every page links to.

## Pages

- [Libraries](./libraries/): all tracked libraries with filters
- [Components](./components/): every component type and which libraries provide it
- [Compare](./compare/): side-by-side matrix with live previews; state in ?libs=a,b&component=x
- [Licenses & AI policy](./guide/licenses-and-ai/): how we use library material and respect AI boundaries

## Source data

- [Repository](https://github.com/AJayClauGermany/SvelteUILibraryPicker): one TypeScript file per library in src/lib/data/libraries/
